api.cartCoupon: Attach a coupon code to the cart, or remove it
api.cartItems: Replace a cart's whole line set
api.cartRecommendations: Cross-sell candidates for the shopper's whole cart
api.categories: The tenant's whole category tree, flat with parent_id
api.checkout: Place an order for a cart's current contents
api.createCart: Start a new guest cart on the calling key's sales channel
api.createWishlist: Start a new, empty wishlist on the calling channel
api.getCart: Fetch a cart's current line items and subtotal
api.getWishlist: Fetch a wishlist by its token
api.intro: No storefront app is attached to this channel -- it's a plain REST API any frontend can call directly.
api.keyNote: Public/anonymous-shopper privilege only -- this channel's own id doubles as its bearer key, same trust model as a Stripe publishable key.
api.magicLink: Email a one-time sign-in link to the given address
api.orderLookup: Guest order-status lookup by order number + billing email
api.paymentIntent: Start an embedded Stripe Elements card payment for this cart's total
api.product: Fetch one enrolled product's full variant/SKU/image detail
api.products: List the calling channel's enrolled catalog
api.recommendations: Products historically bought alongside this one
api.reviews: List a product's reviews, with a rating summary
api.session: Exchange a magic-link token for a signed-in session
api.shippingOptions: Priced delivery options for a shipping address
api.submitReview: Submit a review for a product
api.title: {{name}} — headless API
api.wishlistItems: Add product_id to the wishlist, or remove it

delete.text: Delete {{name}}? Products already synced to it stay listed there — this only removes the enrollment rule.
delete.title: Delete sales channel

empty.text: Add a channel to control which products sync where
empty.title: No sales channels yet

form.currencyConverts: Prices convert via Settings > Localization's exchange rate unless a product has a manual override for it.
form.currencyFixed: Fixed for this channel once created.
form.currencyNoRate: No exchange rate configured for {{currency}} yet -- add one under Settings > Localization, or prices won't convert.
form.defaultEnrollmentHelp: Which products belong on this channel by default. Individual products can still be added or removed later.
form.defaultLocationHelp: Which warehouse this channel's orders and stock sync are attributed to.
form.fulfillmentWarehouseHelp: Required -- every order placed through this channel decrements stock from and ships from this warehouse.
form.internalHelp: A storefront CommerceOS itself hosts checkout for — no external connection needed.
form.paymentHelp: Which connected payment integration an order's payment link is generated through. Connect Stripe or Revolut from the Integrations page first.

pricing.discountHelp: Applied to every product's price on this storefront -- e.g. 20 for a wholesale channel selling at 20% off retail.
pricing.noTiers: No quantity tiers -- every order uses the flat discount above.
pricing.tierDiscountRange: Each quantity tier's discount must be between 0 and 100%.
pricing.tierDuplicate: Two quantity tiers both start at {{quantity}} -- each minimum quantity must be unique.
pricing.tierMinimum: Each quantity tier needs a minimum quantity of at least 1.
pricing.tiersHelp: Buy this many or more of one SKU in a single cart line and get this bigger discount instead of the flat rate above.
pricing.title: Pricing

storefront.headlessHelp: Your own frontend talks to the storefront API. CommerceOS hosts no shop pages.
storefront.label: Storefront
storefront.languageHelp: The language shoppers see: buttons, checkout and messages, and how prices and dates are written.
storefront.signInPageHelp: The page on your own site that completes sign-in. Sign-in emails link here with ?token=… added. Leave empty to turn customer sign-in off.
storefront.themeHelp: CommerceOS also hosts a shop for this channel, designed with the theme editor.
